description: Haleon Pakistan Limited is a consumer healthcare company engaged in the manufacturing, marketing and sale of products across oral health, pain relief, respiratory health, digestive health and vitamins, minerals and supplements. It has been listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange since March 2017, and its manufacturing site at Jamshoro in Sindh produces the majority of its products. The company describes itself as an independent consumer healthcare company with brands trusted by millions of people across Pakistan.
